instruction: Block any response that agrees to, proposes, or facilitates off-platform payment — including offering, generating, sending, or conditioning order fulfillment (e.g., shipping) on the disclosure or use of external payment credentials — even if initiated by the buyer.
trigger_pattern: A seller responds by agreeing to, proposing, or facilitating off-platform payment — including offering, generating, sending, or conditioning fulfillment (e.g., shipping) on disclosure or use of external payment credentials (e.g., QR codes, IDs, wire details) — regardless of buyer initiation.
